name: B10-0162/2025 (Verts/ALE) – The need for EU support towards a just transition and reconstruction in Syria
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the need for EU support towards a just transition and reconstruction in Syria
part_text:
The European Parliament calls on the European Union to help Syria rebuild after the fall of the Assad regime. It asks for money and support for Syrian civil society, especially women's groups, and for help preserving evidence of crimes so victims' families get answers. It wants sanctions lifted step by step so aid and rebuilding can happen, while keeping sanctions on people who committed abuses. It also says Syrian refugees in Europe should not be sent back yet, because the situation is still unsafe.

- The EU is asked to fund reconstruction, aid and justice efforts; this affects Syrians and EU taxpayers.
- Sanctions on Syria's economy should be eased, but not on human rights abusers.
- EU countries should keep assessing Syrian asylum claims fairly and not force returns.
